thread:
maya: kicking off RC creation for v2.14.0-cand1. Target cut 09:00 PT in the change window. Artifacts built: gcr.io/redwood/serving@sha:abc123def. Need QA eyeballs, pin approval, and a quick checklist: KV warm, canary schedule, telemetry gate. Release notes draft here: https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/v2.14.0-cand1 :shipit:

jesse: build is green on CI, integration tests passed. Docker digest matches the artifact listed above. I requested a pin for the candidate (pin for 2h quiet window). I also kicked off a quick staging smoke run.

lin: oncall checklist — I'll own the canary monitor and the rollback path. Reminders: set canary to 10% for 30m, enable kv-warm, and ensure the latency SLO dashboards are pinned. I'll add circuit-breaker thresholds for the embed and chat endpoints.

deploybot: /promote candidate v2.14.0-cand1 --pin --canary=10% --canary-duration=30m --kv-warm=true
deploybot: Promotion job queued -> job_id=77322. View: https://deploys.internal/jobs/77322 

deploybot: job 77322 started. tasks: build->push->deploy->smoke. logs: https://deploys.internal/jobs/77322/logs 

jesse: triggered the smoke suite in staging:```/run-smoke --suite basic --focus inference,embeddings --env staging``` Should be done in ~3m.

deploybot: smoke suite result for job 77322: basic=PASS, inference=PASS, embeddings=PASS. Canary traffic ramping to 10% now.

lin: watching dashboards — traffic ramped. at t+4m I'm seeing a small spike of 5xxs on /v1/embeddings (mostly null payload errors). Not huge but >threshold (error rate ~1.8%). Pausing ramp and triaging.

jesse: looking at logs, seeing tokenizer NPE in the serving layer tied to the new tokenizer cache change (PR #4097). Reproduced locally with representative payloads.

lin: safety vote — recommend abort canary and rollback to baseline. The null responses affect critical downstream processors. @maya what's your call?

maya: ack. we cannot risk propagating this. Abort and rollback. Jesse, if you have a PR revert ready, we can re-originate another candidate after hotfix. For now unpin the candidate.

erik: ops vote recorded: lin=+1 abort, maya=+1 abort, jesse?

jesse: +1 abort, I have a revert PR ready (revert tokenizer cache change). ETA ~25-30m to verify and merge.

deploybot: /rollback job 77322 --reason "canary 5xx spike - tokenizer NPE"

deploybot: Rollback initiated for job 77322. status: IN_PROGRESS -> SUCCESS. Traffic reverted to previous stable. KV cache flush scheduled: /ops/kv/flush job 8877 queued.

lin: rollback complete, traffic baseline restored. I've flagged the candidate as "hold - regression" in the release tracker. Added telemetry snapshot link: https://telemetry.internal/snapshots/77322-spike 

maya: updated release notes and the RC checklist with the regression details. Pushing new timeline: delay 2 hours to allow hotfix merge, smoke, and telemetry bake. New proposed cut 11:00 PT.

jesse: will merge revert PR and run full regression. Will post CI links when done.

oncall-sre: standing by for post-merge monitor. If CI passes and smoke is clean, we can re-request pin.

lin: follow-up action item: add a pre-promote inference-sanity job that runs representative tokenized paths against the candidate (adds to our preflight). Also add a KV-warm verification step.

maya: agreed. thanks all — thread summary in release tracker. :white_check_mark:
